reading_note: The teaching describes the spiritual arc by which Divine Love-and-Wisdom descends through four (or five) discrete degrees of reception to rescue the truth-and-good imprisoned in the natural mind dominated by self-love. Each "face" of Light is a register of the Divine Human's operation: First Man = Divine Truth sent into self-love's domain; Beloved/Living Spirit = power that builds spiritual structure and seizes hostile falsity; Third Ambassador = inner truth-image revealed to extract good from works; Jesus the Splendour = Wisdom that liberates souls from worldly error; Great Counsel = the indwelling life-counsel that, at the end-state, gathers all good and burns away the falsities through the fire of love. Against these stand four counterparts of darkness: the ruling self-love (King), evil counsel (false reasoning binding souls earthward), lust/desire of the flesh, and the law of sin and death — each a discrete degree of corruption mirroring the discrete degrees of reception. The arc moves from emanation → contest with falsity → liberation of imprisoned good → consummation/judgment.
